## Change

Describe the user-visible problem and resulting behavior.

## Verification

State the checks performed, client/browser versions actually exercised, and any remaining limits.

## Cross-repository impact

Related PRs and adoption order, or “none”. If a shared kit or handoff changes, state its exact revision/version and compatibility with apps that have not updated yet.

Include the tested source commit and local results in Verification. Distinguish compilation, browser checks and native/device testing. Actions remain disabled; do not claim missing hosted checks passed.

## App Store impact

For listing/release changes, link the local marketing brief and completed playbook release packet: selected build, verified claims, asset story/rights, rendered review, locales, eligibility/experiment plan and actual ASC status. Otherwise state not applicable. Marketing drafts or uploads alone do not establish a public release.

## Connected requirements and local context

Record the shared-policy check/revision, relevant tools actually used and local test/render results. Update PROJECT_CONTEXT.md and the actual design requirements if affected. For UI/release work, link current research and language coverage/default/RTL evidence, or explicitly state gaps/not applicable. Do not claim this policy update translated the app.
